hooks.name: log-spec-task-to-kiro-log
hooks.description: After each spec task, append one line to docs/kiro-log.md. This log feeds the hackathon write-up on how Kiro was used.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Append exactly one new row to the table in docs/kiro-log.md with: today's date, the spec name and task number, which Kiro feature did the work (spec task / hook / steering / MCP / PBT / vibe), a one-sentence outcome, and whether anything went wrong or needed human correction. Do not rewrite existing rows.
